title: Functoriality and transitivity triangle for cotangent complexes of schemes
statement:
Let $X\xrightarrow{a}Y\xrightarrow{b}Z$ be arbitrary morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Use the intrinsic cotangent complexes $L_{X/Y}$, $L_{Y/Z}$ and $L_{X/Z}$ of [lem-trf-lci-cotangent-presentation], defined without any lci hypothesis by the standard polynomial-resolution construction. In $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category] there is a canonical distinguished triangle
$$La^*L_{Y/Z}\xrightarrow{u_{a,b}}L_{X/Z}\longrightarrow L_{X/Y}\longrightarrow (La^*L_{Y/Z})[1].$$
Here $La^*$ is the derived module pullback, computed by flat resolutions before tensoring, and ordinary module pullback is [def-pc-module-pullback]. The arrow $u_{a,b}$ is the canonical cotangent functoriality arrow. These arrows commute with restriction to open subschemes. For any further morphism $c:W\to X$, after the canonical derived pullback composition identification,
$$u_{a\circ c,b}=u_{c,b\circ a}\circ Lc^*(u_{a,b}).$$
The arrow for an identity source map is the identity. The canonical augmentations $L_{Y/Z}\to\Omega^1_{Y/Z}[0]$ and $L_{X/Z}\to\Omega^1_{X/Z}[0]$ induce $H^0(L_{Y/Z})=\Omega^1_{Y/Z}$ and $H^0(L_{X/Z})=\Omega^1_{X/Z}$, with differentials [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. They commute with $u_{a,b}$ and the differential map: if $a$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], then $H^0(u_{a,b})$ is exactly $a^*\Omega^1_{Y/Z}\to\Omega^1_{X/Z}$, locally $r\otimes\mathrm ds\mapsto r\,\mathrm d(a^\sharp s)$. No separation, finite type, Noetherianity, smoothness or etaleness is assumed.

source.place: Tag 08T4 (lemma-triangle-ringed-spaces), applied to schemes as in Tag 08T2 (definition-cotangent-morphism-schemes); Tag 08UV (lemma-H0-L-morphism-ringed-spaces); the canonical functorial maps of Tag 08QL (section-functoriality) and the sheaf standard-resolution construction in Tags 08SR, 08SS, 08SV. The composition and augmentation clauses spell out functoriality of this construction.

proof.text: Use the flat K-flat models and canonical maps of [lem-sfb-standard-sheaf-cotangent-flat-functorial-model]. For injective $\mathcal B\to\mathcal C$, [lem-sfb-injective-sheaf-cotangent-sequence-roof] gives a short exact sequence and a canonical roof identifying its quotient with $L_{\mathcal C/\mathcal B}$, including its arrow. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-triangle]; [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] identifies the first term with derived scalar extension. This gives the required triangle of ring sheaves in the injective case.

source.place: Tag 08SZ (lemma-triangle-sheaves-rings), injective case, displayed differential sequence and canonical roof; Tags 08SD (remark-triangle) and 08SE (remark-explicit-map).

proof.text: For arbitrary $j:\mathcal B\to\mathcal C$, apply Step 1 to $\mathcal A\to\mathcal B\to\mathcal D=\mathcal B\times\mathcal C$ via the injective graph $b\mapsto(b,jb)$, then $-\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal D}\mathcal C$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] on the K-flat models of [lem-sfb-standard-sheaf-cotangent-flat-functorial-model]. On sections $D\to C$ is localization at $e=(0,1)$: $d/e^n\mapsto\operatorname{pr}_C(d)$, inverse $c\mapsto(0,c)/e$. The localization clause of [lem-trf-affine-cotangent-comparison] (source set $\{1\}$) for $A\to D$ and $B\to D$, with [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-site-module-sheafification-exact, lem-pc-sites-module-sheafification-tensor], identifies the last two terms with $L_{\mathcal C/\mathcal A}$, $L_{\mathcal C/\mathcal B}$; the first by $(v\otimes d)\otimes c\mapsto v\otimes\operatorname{pr}_C(d)c$. These comparisons are standard maps for squares through $\operatorname{pr}_C$, so by strict composition both arrows become the standard ones for $\mathcal A\to\mathcal B\to\mathcal C$, compatibly with open restriction.

On $X$ set $\mathcal A=(ba)^{-1}\mathcal O_Z$, $\mathcal B=a^{-1}\mathcal O_Y$, $\mathcal C=\mathcal O_X$. By [lem-trf-lci-cotangent-presentation, lem-cbc-normalized-alternating-homotopy-equivalence] the three intrinsic complexes are these standard sheaf complexes, and the inverse-image clause of [lem-trf-affine-cotangent-comparison] gives $a^{-1}L_{Y/Z}=L_{\mathcal B/\mathcal A}$, flat K-flat; so [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] gives $La^*L_{Y/Z}=L_{\mathcal B/\mathcal A}\otimes_{\mathcal B}\mathcal O_X$ and Step 2 is the scheme triangle with first arrow $u_{a,b}$. For $c:W\to X$, $Lc^*$ is computed on these models, which stay flat K-flat. By the inverse-image and consecutive-map clauses of [lem-sfb-standard-sheaf-cotangent-flat-functorial-model] and $s\otimes(r\otimes v)\mapsto s\,c^\sharp(r)\otimes v$, both sides of the composition law send $s\otimes\mathrm dp$ to $s\,\mathrm d((ac)^\sharp p)$; identity maps give identities.

Apply [lem-sfb-standard-sheaf-cotangent-augmentation] to the two structure-ring maps. [lem-trf-topos-inverse-image-differentials] identifies inverse-image differentials; the natural augmentation square gives the claimed formula. For flat $a$, [lem-weil-pbc-flat-module-pullback-exact-pushforward-injective] makes $a^*$ exact, so it commutes with $H^0$ and $H^0(La^*L_{Y/Z})=a^*\Omega^1_{Y/Z}$. No other geometric hypothesis was used.
